name: The Harvest Supper
description: Big platters down the middle of the table and everyone reaching across. Our most-booked wedding and rehearsal-dinner menu.

name: The Long Table
description: One unbroken table of cheeses, cured meats, roasted vegetables and bread, built on site and replenished all evening.

name: Passed and Poured
description: Eight small bites carried through the room on trays, and a bar that pours one seasonal cocktail alongside wine and beer.

name: The Working Lunch
description: A lunch people talk about in the afternoon meeting. Delivered, labeled for every diet and set out by noon.
